name: Anna Lambe
bio: Anna Rynee Bridget Lambe (born September 25, 2000) is a Canadian Inuk actress. Her debut screen role was in the sports drama film, The Grizzlies (2018), for which she received a nomination for the Canadian Screen Award for Best Supporting Actress at the 7th Canadian Screen Awards. Lambe also is known for her roles in Heart of the Beast (2026), The Social Reckoning (2026) and True Detective: Night Country.

credits.title: The Social Reckoning
credits.overview: Frances Haugen, a young Facebook engineer, enlists the help of Jeff Horwitz, a Wall Street Journal reporter, to go on a dangerous journey that ends up blowing the whistle on the social network's most guarded secrets.

credits.title: Heart of the Beast
credits.overview: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.

credits.title: In the Heart of the South
credits.overview: Yura Ivalu is an ambitious Inuk multimedia artist who spirals out of control when an estranged childhood friend, Sesi Ilupaalik, forces Yura to confront the trauma she’s built her career on and the identity she built as an avenue to escape.

credits.title: Dusk & Dawn
credits.overview: We follow Dusk & Dawn, two exes who rekindle their love on the night of their high school graduation. As they navigate the night with their friends, they get pulled into a love triangle that leaves Dawn desperate to decide: stay home and give this another shot, or move away for good and start university.

credits.title: The Grizzlies
credits.overview: In a small Arctic town struggling with the highest suicide rate in North America, a group of Inuit students' lives are transformed when they are introduced to the sport of lacrosse.
